layers.message: Record project context for archive export
Add CSV export to the document archive

graderOnly: Scope AC-003 requires every export request to receive a response within the configured export time limit (default 30 seconds), failing with 504 otherwise.

The technical design says transient archive upload failures (network error or 5xx) are retried after retryDelayMs, but it never says how many times, whether retries stop, or whether the export time limit spans all uploads or applies to each upload request. It does not say how the remaining time is passed to each upload. Nothing else in the repository (context, scope, docs) establishes these choices; CONTEXT.md lists the archive contract as a known unknown.

The design's only AC-003 technical criterion (an upload that exceeds the time limit gives 504) is satisfiable per upload request and does not by itself bound the whole export, so the design cannot satisfy AC-003 as written.

The implementation in src/routes/export.ts retries transient archive failures in an unbounded for (;;) loop and applies exportTimeoutMs to each upload request separately, so an archive that keeps answering 503 (or keeps failing to connect) makes an export request never complete.
All 27 existing tests pass; none exercises a persistently failing archive. The route tests cover one 503 followed by success, a single hanging upload (504 after 20 ms), and a 400 (502).

The correct outcome is an ARCHITECTURE failure routed to ARCHITECTING with a recovery frame From TESTING, ResumeAt TESTING, RerunThrough NONE; an implementation finding about the unbounded retry may also be recorded but cannot be corrected without the missing design decision.
